en-US.name: Agent Toolkit for AWS Skills
en-US.summary: 118 skills from the AWS-maintained toolkit for development, deployment, data, security and operations. Instructions only: separately configure each skill’s CLI/SDK, MCP, runtime, account and IAM access. Cloud resources and external services may incur charges; stop when prerequisites are missing.
en-US.description:
Lists the 118 skills in the canonical `skills/` directory of the AWS-maintained Agent Toolkit for AWS at commit `e8c630949189f03b3dd77388c86b06a7f2f911a9`. Duplicate copies under `plugins/` are excluded. Select skills as needed. Upstream IDs and paths are preserved. Chinese catalog names and summaries do not translate the predominantly English skill bodies or reference materials.

This listing provides pointers to skill instructions only. Installing it does not install AWS CLI, SDKs, Node.js/npm, Python, Swift, CDK/SAM, Docker, database clients or AWS Transform (ATX) CLI. It does not register AWS MCP / WorkSpaces Agent Access MCP, install host plugins, sign in to AWS, create accounts, grant IAM access or pay for services. Follow the selected skill’s pinned tooling and version requirements: for example, `aws login` requires AWS CLI >= 2.32.0, and AWS Transform requires WSL or another supported environment rather than native Windows.

Many skills work through the local AWS CLI/SDK; AWS MCP is not a universal hard dependency. MCP workflows require separately configured compatible tool mappings, uv/uvx and proxy runtime, endpoints and authorization; specialized workflows such as remote desktop access may require their own MCP service. Select workflows from the actual tools available. Installing instructions does not establish a service connection. Public documentation access does not establish access to account resources.

Before execution, read the selected skill and associated resources; verify tool versions, platform, connection readiness, target account/Region and least-privilege access. If a dependency, credential, permission or service is missing, explain the blocker and stop before that external call. Never fabricate execution, deployment or test results. Obtain explicit user authorization before installing/updating external software, signing in, uploading data, changing IAM, creating/deleting resources, sending messages, shifting traffic or running fault injection. Confirm scope, costs and recovery first. Never paste credentials into chat or public files.

The snapshot’s source is Apache-2.0 licensed, with root LICENSE and NOTICE evidence. This does not license AWS, database, model, messaging, payment or other external services. AWS resources, APIs, quantum devices, model inference, messaging and third-party providers may incur separate charges and remain subject to their own terms, subscriptions, quotas and regional availability.

This is an independent community listing with unverified maintainer identity; it does not imply AWS endorsement of DesireCore or this listing. Review covers the pinned source, inventory, metadata, licensing and prerequisite disclosure only, not software safety certification. An isolated macOS DesireCore 10.0.187 instance verified the 118-item inventory and Chinese summaries, and installed three representative children through the market GUI: aws-cloudformation, aws-compute and aws-sdk-python-usage. Installation locks were written and all 31 files matched the pinned snapshot. Supporting scripts, AWS account operations and all 118 business workflows were not exercised; Windows/Linux were not tested.

zh-CN.description:
收录 AWS 官方维护的 Agent Toolkit for AWS 在固定快照 `e8c630949189f03b3dd77388c86b06a7f2f911a9` 的 118 个技能。仅枚举规范 `skills/` 目录，排除 `plugins/` 中的重复副本；可按需选择技能。技能 ID 与原始路径保持不变，中文仅用于市场名称和摘要，上游技能正文及参考资料以英文为主，未翻译。

本条目只提供技能指引的来源入口。安装它不会自动安装 AWS CLI、SDK、Node.js/npm、Python、Swift、CDK/SAM、Docker、数据库客户端或 AWS Transform（ATX）CLI，也不会注册 AWS MCP / WorkSpaces Agent Access MCP、安装宿主插件、登录 AWS、创建账户、授予 IAM 权限或支付费用。具体工具和版本要求以所选技能的固定快照为准；例如 `aws login` 要求 AWS CLI >= 2.32.0，AWS Transform 不支持原生 Windows，需 WSL 或其他受支持环境。

许多技能可以通过本地 AWS CLI/SDK 使用，AWS MCP 不是所有技能的统一硬依赖。选择 MCP 流程时需另行配置兼容的工具映射、uv/uvx 与代理运行环境、服务端点和授权；远程桌面等专用技能可能需要独立 MCP 服务。应按实际工具列表选择流程，不把仅安装技能当作已接通服务。公开文档查询不等于已具备访问账户资源的权限。

执行前先阅读所选技能与相关资源，核对工具版本、平台、连接状态、目标账户/区域及最小权限。缺少依赖、凭据、授权或服务时，说明阻碍并在相应外部调用前停止；不能编造执行、部署或测试结果。需用户明确授权后才安装或更新外部软件、登录、上传数据、修改 IAM、创建/删除资源、发送消息、切换流量或执行故障注入实验；先确认范围、成本和恢复方案。不要在对话或公共文件中粘贴凭据。

这是独立的 community 市场登记，未验证维护者身份，不代表 AWS 对 DesireCore 或此登记的背书。审核仅覆盖固定来源、技能清单、元数据、许可和依赖披露，不是软件安全认证；已在 macOS DesireCore 10.0.187 的独立实例核对 118 项清单与中文摘要，并通过市场界面安装 aws-cloudformation、aws-compute、aws-sdk-python-usage 三个代表子技能；安装锁已写入，31 个文件与固定快照逐项匹配。未执行这些技能的配套脚本或 AWS 账户业务，未验收全部 118 项业务流程，Windows/Linux 未实测。
